field_principles.field_principles: A principle for every field makes the receipt auditable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Recorded local checks prevent invented evidence and precede network access.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed date closes the allowed publication window.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate limits claims to source and cache aggregation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The class separates aggregation from a blocked no-run.
field_principles.execution_venue: The host venue prevents an unattached hardware claim.
field_principles.duration_s: Elapsed time shows that the refresh workflow executed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the output to its local planning inputs.
field_principles.rows: Combined typed rows support an independent consistency check.
field_principles.arxiv_rows: Primary paper rows preserve dated method facts.
field_principles.openreview_rows: Author venue records do not imply review acceptance.
field_principles.semantic_scholar_rows: Citation routes remain secondary discovery receipts.
field_principles.huggingface_rows: Community paper pages stay below primary sources.
field_principles.github_rows: Repository discovery does not prove method fitness.
field_principles.extropic_rows: Vendor writing does not prove local hardware execution.
field_principles.logical_intelligence_rows: A product page cannot replace a public runner.
field_principles.source_class_rows: One canonical identity prevents class drift and duplication.
field_principles.model_repository_rows: Repository access records state without downloading weights.
field_principles.cached_model_rows: Exact local file and template facts support reproduction.
field_principles.task_method_map_rows: Only methods that change a V629 task receive a map.
field_principles.deferred_rows: Deferrals preserve useful leads without expanding scope.
field_principles.reference_append_marker: Marker counts and a hash prove append idempotence.
field_principles.v629_source_delta_complete_score: One means all source, cache, map, and append checks agree.
field_principles.random_seed: The fixed seed records deterministic row ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable payload hash detects later evidence drift.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact expected and observed values make a block actionable.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this audit does not certify correctness.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class separates null, blocked, and invalid outcomes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-aligned prefix gives automation an exact outcome.
